keyDecisions: Swipe-to-complete as default, long-press as optional setting
UIKit integration for gestures per CLAUDE.md guidance
Theme protocol for future palette extensibility
Low Power Mode also disables animations
Default haptic intensity is 'selective' for ADHD sensory considerations
Key moments for haptics: success, error, completion, swipe threshold
learnings: Warm off-white (#FFFDF7) provides excellent readability while feeling inviting
92 design tokens defined covering colors, spacing, radius, shadows, durations, and opacities
ThemeProtocol with 31 color properties covers all semantic needs
@Observable ThemeManager with UserDefaults persistence works well
22 typography styles defined including SF Rounded and monospaced variants
21 animation tokens defined including spring configs and easing curves
UISpringConfig provides UIKit bridge for gesture-driven animations
SwiftUI Animation type doesn't have .none - use .linear(duration: 0) instead
HapticEngine with protocol allows NoOpHapticEngine for previews/testing
HapticEngineProtocol requires AnyObject constraint for weak references
CADisplayLink with preferredFrameRateRange enables 120fps on ProMotion
SwiftUI UIViewRepresentable wraps UIKit gesture handlers for seamless integration
